messages:
alex: Heads-up — planning a rolling NIC firmware swap + graceful node reboots across our edge egress pool (edge-us-west1). Want to do minimal disruption, ETA Sat 02:00-05:00 UTC.

maria: +1. Which racks/pools are in scope?

alex: target pools: edge-eu/edge-us-west1/edge-apac-small (only the egress-facing nodes). Roughly 120 nodes total, will cordon in cohorts of 8-10 nodes.

priya: Do we have capacity to backfill traffic? We should avoid dropping active sessions for dedicated customers.

jonathan: We can route most traffic to hosted-capacity fallback (lower perf but available). Proposal: 25% traffic routed to hosted for the window, rest stays but with slight latency SLO relaxation.

kevin: Cost note — falling back to hosted for ~3 hours will add ~USD 7k in burst spend. We should confirm billing approval.

alex: noted on cost. @kevin can you get quick approval from finance? We might reduce window to 2.5h if we tighten the cohorts.

maria: Runbook draft attached: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/edge-nic-swap. Key steps in case a node fails to rejoin: 1) drain -> remove from pool -> reprovision -> reattach.

alex: Operational checklist (short):
```
- preheat prefix cache
- announce traffic shift in router (2 min rollout)
- cordon cohort (8 nodes)
- graceful drain (kubectl drain --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data)
- apply NIC FW, reboot
- verify kernel & NIC link, bring back
- uncordon, validate telemetry
```

priya: Suggest adding a quick KV-cache warm step after reattach to avoid cold-token penalty.

jonathan: Agree. Also add healthcheck: `curl -sS http://internal-health/edge/ready | jq .status` should be OK before we uncordon.

deploy-bot: Scheduled maintenance created: maintenance-id=mn-2026-005, start=5051239876, end=5051249000, affected=edge-us-west1; ping @oncall.

alex: @sre-bot can you coordinate pager suppressions for the window? We want only high-severity pager to hit oncall.

sre-bot: Pager suppression applied for non-critical alerts from 5051239800 to 5051243600. Critical alerts remain live.

kevin: Finance approved up to USD 10k for emergency burst. :thumbsup:

maria: One caveat — we've seen asymmetric egress NAT state clearing after NIC swaps in the past. Add network gating: wait 5m after NIC up before resuming traffic to allow NAT tables to rebuild.

alex: good call. We'll fold that into the runbook step `post-reboot wait 300s`.

priya: Who's riding this? I can be primary during the window and hand off to jonathan at 03:30 UTC.

alex: thanks. Owner timeline: priya (01:50-03:30 UTC) -> jonathan (03:30-05:15 UTC).

maria: I'll post the customer comms snippet shortly for the status page (brief, non-technical).

alex: final ask: if any cohort has >2 nodes fail to rejoin, abort window and escalate to infra leads.

kevin: noted. I'll watch cost and open a rapid finance channel if we exceed projected spend.

maria: ready to go on Saturday. PR with runbook updates is out for review. :white_check_mark:
